title: Spielberg's tip about the Ariel School landing in Africa

tellings.quote: on UFOs he should look into this Landing

plain: A documentary filmmaker named James Fox tells podcast host Jesse Michels that the film director Steven Spielberg, through a producer named Janet Yang, pointed him to a reported landing at the Ariel School in Ruwa, Zimbabwe, in the 1990s. Fox says the tip was that anyone serious about UFOs should look into this landing, which, if true, would mean even Spielberg considered it an important case.
